lines.text: Moses tells Israel he is a hundred and twenty years old and the LORD will cross ahead of them.
Moses tells Joshua to be strong, then gives the written law to the priests, the sons of Levi, and elders.
Moses commands that every seven years, at the Feast of Passover, the law be read to all Israel.
The LORD tells Moses to bring Joshua to the Tent of Meeting, and appears there in a pillar of fire.
Moses tells the Levites to place the Book of the Law beside the ark as a witness against Israel.
